principle: Learn process-conditioned dimensionless relations across independent regions; use local datasets only for validation and exclusion tests.
preferredTargets: pinch-out rate per normalized section length
preservation probability conditioned on accommodation and sediment supply
promotionRules: A DatasetSpecific record cannot set a generation prior.
Country or locality alone cannot select lithology order or geometry.
Dimensional coefficients retain units and process scope.
A relationship failing holdout-region validation remains a hypothesis.
Regional deviations are profiles layered over the universal engine, never hard-coded into it.
localDatasetRole: regional profile evidence after universal-rule selection
